title: REQ-18 revisit: Performance Engineer's place in the domain partition

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Context (deferred from #840, operator ruling 2026-07-31 'leave omitted, revisit'): REQ-18's process-governing baseline is SO/SA/SE/QE + AI-Engineer/Platform-Engineer/Red-Team/Security/Data-Engineer/Documentation-Reviewer/Technical-Writer — it OMITS Performance Engineer. But the phase-1a primer's always-on baseline reads 'SE + QE + SA + SO; PE + PerfE if the project ships code.' So PerfE is currently treated as code-shipping-activated, not unconditionally process-governing. To settle: is PerfE (a) product/code-shipping-activated (matches the primer; REQ-18 omission stands), (b) process-governing baseline (inherited by every adopter), or (c) resolved by the composition function treating 'ships code' as an axis that activates PerfE? Blocks nothing; revisit after #840 lands. This project (vsdd-core ships Rust) activates PerfE regardless.
